method: exact coordinates on a scalene 13-14-15 triangle (all four centres rational): centroid = plate centre of mass (first-moment formula), circumcentre = equidistant from corners (linear system), orthocentre = intersection of altitudes, incentre = equal signed distances to the side lines; every stem property is evaluated for each of the four centres and exactly one must satisfy it. Lines (median / altitude / perpendicular bisector / angle bisector) are tested by incidence and perpendicularity. Right-triangle items on the 3-4-5 triangle
assumptions: Only properties implied by the stem count (an isosceles special case is not assumed); "an altitude / a median / an angle bisector" are judged on a scalene triangle.
